question: What degree of loss is considered auspicious when earlier stages are properly observed, O twice-born ones?
premises: Earlier stages are to be properly observed
Proper observance makes the outcome auspicious
Only a small loss may occur in that case
inference: If the earlier stages are properly observed, the result is auspicious and any loss is small, O twice-born ones.
uncertainties: yādi taken as a variant of yadi
plain_english: O twice-born ones, if the earlier stages are properly observed, it is auspicious and any loss will be small.
